rule: A stable signal references a less stable attribute only at opt_in.

pattern: family never has a baseline|set its `BASELINE` empty|a `-dev` family included\) empty

rule: A layout file the repo already has takes the layout's content, keeping the repo's pins, additions and formatting rules; prose files are merged.
In an update or a subdirectory project, copy file by file, except a directory holding only layout files.
The repo's formatting rules for the file types it formats stay the repo's.
Never add a collection nobody asked for (apart from attribute-groups with attributes).
gh run list --commit needs the full 40-character sha; a short one matches nothing.
Engine-enforcing package managers can refuse npm run/npx/npm exec; call binaries from node_modules/.bin.

A repo's own Renovate validator asking for an unversioned renovate gets an old release on a Node newer than the latest supports: make it use versions.env's RENOVATE_VERSION; fileMatch only for a validator pinned old on purpose.
The layout's workflows use $/ for local actions: zizmor reports ./ as self-repository.
Read every copied file before editing it, whether cp created it or replaced one you had read.
pattern: read every copied file before editing it

rule: In an update with release, copy make package's output before touching anything (the inventory step), not in Verify.
New conventions' default stability is the repo's or the user's, else development, whatever the registry's stability; the doc skeletons fill it in.
Code generated from one existing registry, all of it or some keys, is a consumer: codegen alone, no registry of its own.
